title: At Fenerbahçe, İsmail Kartal is finalizing the starting lineup for the derby! He’s exploring different options
text:

He’s exploring different options At Fenerbahçe, İsmail Kartal is finalizing the starting lineup for the derby! He’s exploring different options
 25 October 2026, Sunday 09:42 Last Update: 25.10.2026 09:42 As Fenerbahçe continues its preparations for the derby against Galatasaray in Week 9 of the Super League, the coaching staff’s plans for the starting lineup are beginning to take shape. While the lineup for the Yellow-and-Blues has largely been determined, uncertainty remains regarding three positions. The status of the star players on the offensive line and an injury in the defense have led the coaching staff to consider different options ahead of the derby.

kaynak olarak ekleyin With Fenerbahçe set to face Galatasaray on the road in Week 9 of the Trendyol Super League, all eyes are on the lineup the coaching staff will field. As the Yellow-and-Blues continue their preparations ahead of this crucial match, the evaluation process for the starting 11 is nearing its conclusion. It has been reported that the coaching staff has largely finalized its selections for all but three positions.
 Read More › 
 In particular, the choices for center forward, the “No. 10” who will direct the offensive organization, and the left side of the defense are among the most important questions awaiting answers ahead of the derby.
 MURIÇ-LUKAKU COMPETITION UP FRONT 
 One of the most important decisions Fenerbahçe will make ahead of the derby is the choice of striker. The coaching staff will choose between Vedat Muriqi and Romelu Lukaku to lead the attack against Galatasaray.
 The two players’ distinct characteristics could directly influence the Yellow-and-Blues’ offensive strategy. While Muriqi’s effectiveness in aerial duels and his role in link-up play stand out, Lukaku’s physical strength and finishing ability in the penalty area are being considered as the other option. The coaching staff is expected to make its decision based on the players’ performances in recent training sessions.
 Read More › 
 TWO DIFFERENT PLANS FOR GREENWOOD 
 Another uncertainty in Fenerbahçe’s attacking lineup lies in the number 10 position. The coaching staff may consider deploying Mason Greenwood in this role, as they did in the match against Slavia Prague. If Greenwood plays as the number 10, the plan is for Oğuz Aydın to start on the right side of the attack and Kerem Aktürkoğlu on the left. In the other option, İrfan Can Kahveci moving into the number 10 position is on the table. In this scenario, Greenwood would play on the right wing, while Oğuz Aydın would play on the left. These two different formations are expected to be decisive in shaping Fenerbahçe’s attacking organization and the players’ roles on the field during the derby.
 AKE’S INJURY HAS CHANGED THE DEFENSIVE PLAN 
 Another issue giving the technical staff of the Yellow-and-Blues pause is the left side of the defense. Due to Nathan Ake’s injury, Archie Brown and Oppong are being considered for the left center-back position. If Archie Brown forms a center-back pairing with Milan Skriniar, Levent Mercan is expected to play left back.
 If Oppong is selected for the starting 11, however, Archie Brown is planned to move to his natural position at left back. It is noted that the coaching staff will take defensive cohesion and the necessary precautions against Galatasaray’s attacking players into account when making this decision.
 Read More › 
 MIDFIELD AND RIGHT BACK POSITIONS SET 
 Despite the uncertainty in three positions, it is reported that the plan for central midfield and right back is largely set. Fenerbahçe’s coaching staff is considering fielding the duo of N’Golo Kante and Matteo Guendouzi in the center of midfield for the Galatasaray derby.
 At right back, Nelson Semedo is expected to start in the first 11. Thus, it is anticipated that Fenerbahçe will maintain its current player selections, particularly in midfield and on the right side of the defense.
